item.title: Actors Circle to present ‘A Midsummer Night’s Dream’
item.description: Actors Circle will present William Shakespeare’s comedy, “A Midsummer Night’s Dream,” at Providence Playhouse in Scranton, March 12 through March 22, with shows at 7 p.m. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday and at 2 p.m. Sunday.

item.title: VFW Auxiliary is selling ‘Pocono Cheesecakes’
item.description: Shopa Davey Post 6082 VFW Auxiliary will hold a “Pocono Cheesecake” fundraiser, with cheesecakes available for pickup from noon to 5 p.m. on April 1 and April 2.

item.title: Noem defends her portrayal of killed Minneapolis protesters as agitators, in her Senate hearing
item.description: WASHINGTON — Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem defended her department’s immigration enforcement tactics in front of a Senate committee on Tuesday and pushed back against criticism from Democrats who say she wrongly disparaged two protesters killed by federal officers in Minneapolis earlier this year.

item.title: With 100 days to go, World Cup faces plenty of new challenges
item.description: GENEVA — With 100 days to go until the World Cup, the Iran war has added a new layer of complexity to the tournament co-hosted by the United States, Mexico and Canada.

item.title: Cardinals inform QB Kyler Murray they plan to release him next week
item.description: TEMPE, Ariz. — The Arizona Cardinals have informed two-time Pro Bowl quarterback Kyler Murray that they plan to release him at the beginning of the new league year on March 11, a person familiar with the decision told The Associated Press.

item.title: Colts place transition tag on Jones; Hall gets franchise tag from Jets
item.description: The Indianapolis Colts placed a transition tag on quarterback Daniel Jones and the New York Jets used the franchise tag on running back Breece Hall as teams beat the deadline Tuesday to place tags on potential free agents.

item.title: Rice Township Supervisors approve data center regulations
item.description: RICE TWP. — Rice Township Board of Supervisors approved a zoning ordinance Tuesday regulating data centers in the Mountain Top community.

item.title: David M. Drucker: Don’t confuse the Iran war’s MAGA critics with most Republicans
item.description: There’s a joke circulating in political circles opposed to President Donald Trump that encapsulates the dilemma facing some of his most ardent supporters in the wake of ongoing U.S. military strikes on Iran. The current variation goes something like this: “They told me that if I voted for Kamala Harris, we’d get more regime-change wars in the Middle East — and they were right!”
